changelog:
@Announcements Ping Hi I released a very small hotfix for Retro Rewind, mainly for wii users to fix the stuttering online lol. The changelog is below:

```- The Framerate option for 30 fps now applies in menus as well as races.
- Optimized the custom character related code. This should have no difference in actual gameplay.
- Fixed an issue where specific custom revo kart files would cause SW2 Rainbow Road to crash.
- Fixed an issue where the player count changing would cause wii players to freeze for a second or two on the WFC menus.
- Other minor bug fixes and improvements.```

Full Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip
New files only since 6.12.7: https://cdn.update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/6.12.8.zip

Next update will be a track update finally, this should be it for the hotfixes LOL
